current_frozen_facts.source_dataset: 田间商品果每日采摘净重汇总

semantic_boundary.unknown_not_zero_interpretation: Absence must not be numerically imputed as 0 kg; it does not independently identify a missing business day.

decision_authority_provenance.limitation: Current-main evidence names these roles for source/completeness governance but does not uniquely prove which role may accept the missingness denominator and formula for final attestation.

candidate_options.definition: Count canonical S1 calendar dates in the coverage interval on which the entire governed source scope has zero canonical S1 rows.
candidate_options.expected_date_universe: All local calendar dates from 2025-08-05 through 2026-04-16 inclusive.
candidate_options.missing_day_count_formula: count(expected calendar dates with zero governed canonical S1 rows across the entire source scope)
candidate_options.semantic_limit: This measures a source-wide complete-day gap and not canonical-grain completeness for individual groups.
candidate_options.july_denominator_treatment: 2025-07-22 is excluded from the canonical S1 denominator because it is raw-retained and canonical-excluded; this treatment remains a decision input, not an accepted formula.
strengths: Does not count pre-harvest or post-harvest group lifecycle days as missing.
risks: A day with one source row hides possible absence for other groups.
Cannot distinguish no harvest from missing source data without independent authority.

candidate_options.definition: Expand every canonical SEASON × FARM × SUBFARM × VARIETY group across the full canonical S1 date interval and count group-days without a governed row.
candidate_options.expected_date_universe: All local calendar dates from 2025-08-05 through 2026-04-16 inclusive.
candidate_options.expected_group_universe: All 529 mapped canonical groups × the canonical S1 calendar interval.
candidate_options.missing_day_count_formula: count(expected group-days with no governed in-scope Source 002 row)
candidate_options.semantic_limit: The schema field name missing_day_count would carry GROUP_DAY units under this option and requires explicit authority approval for that reinterpretation.
candidate_options.july_denominator_treatment: 2025-07-22 is excluded from the canonical S1 denominator by the current scope boundary; this remains a decision input.
risks: Pre-activity and post-activity lifecycle days can be systematically overcounted as missing.
Row absence still does not prove a source-data failure.

candidate_options.definition: For each canonical group, expand dates from its first observed governed harvest date through its last observed governed harvest date and count dates without that group's governed row.
candidate_options.expected_date_universe: Each canonical group's observed first-to-last governed date span.
candidate_options.expected_group_universe: Canonical groups with an observed governed span; lifecycle spans are group-specific.
candidate_options.missing_day_count_formula: sum(active-group dates with no governed row for that group)
candidate_options.missing_data_proportion_formula: sum(active-group missing group-days) / sum(active-group expected span days)
candidate_options.semantic_limit: An empty date inside an observed span may still be a normal no-harvest day and cannot alone prove source missingness.
candidate_options.july_denominator_treatment: 2025-07-22 is excluded from canonical S1 group spans because its rows are canonical-excluded; this remains a decision input.
strengths: Avoids counting all pre-start and post-end lifecycle dates.
More structurally targeted than the full Cartesian expansion.
risks: Still cannot distinguish no-harvest from missing data without expected-recording authority.
The resulting metric is a heuristic unless its semantics are explicitly accepted.

candidate_options.definition: Include only canonical group-days independently declared by an authority as expected harvest or expected recording days; count declared days with no governed Source 002 row.
candidate_options.expected_date_universe: Authority-declared expected recording days for canonical groups.
candidate_options.expected_group_universe: Canonical group-days included by the independent expected-harvest/expected-recording authority.
candidate_options.missing_day_count_formula: count(authority-declared expected group-days with no governed Source 002 row)
candidate_options.missing_data_proportion_formula: missing expected group-days / all authority-declared expected group-days
candidate_options.semantic_limit: Requires an independent expected-harvest or expected-recording authority; Source 002 row presence cannot create this denominator by itself.
candidate_options.july_denominator_treatment: Authority must explicitly decide whether any 2025-07-22 expected days exist; current canonical scope recommends exclusion but does not accept it as a new formula decision.
strengths: Best distinguishes no harvest from expected-but-unrecorded data.
risks: Requires a new independently governed authority and evidence artifact.

candidate_options.definition: Keep both fields unresolved until an independent completeness or expected-recording authority defines the expected universe and formula.
candidate_options.expected_date_universe: Not computable from Source 002 and current governance alone.
candidate_options.expected_group_universe: Not computable from Source 002 and current governance alone.
candidate_options.semantic_limit: This is the fail-closed state, not a final attestation value.
candidate_options.july_denominator_treatment: Requires explicit authority before any denominator is formed.
strengths: Does not equate row absence with true missingness.
Avoids inventing denominator, formula, precision, or completeness claims.
risks: Leaves the two schema-required fields unresolved and blocks final attestation issuance.

decision_records.decision_authority_basis: Current-main D-005/source-governance evidence identifies the source owner role for completeness declaration but does not uniquely authorize a missing-day denominator or semantic unit.
decision_inputs_required: zero-denominator behavior if the expected universe is empty

decision_records.decision_authority_basis: Current-main evidence does not issue a numerator, denominator, zero-denominator policy, precision, or rounding authority for this schema field.

july_boundary.current_canonical_scope_interpretation: 2025-07-22 does not enter the canonical S1 missingness denominator because its two raw rows are retained but canonical-excluded.
